column2: which injects them into /Quake/common on boot.vhd.

column1: # The id Software Quake SHAREWARE episode (Episode 1
# Doomed") is the one distributable piece: its pak0.pak is what the
# `Shareware` instance plays.  It is still governed by id's shareware licence
# so it may only be offered from a URL that is authorised to host it.
# Format — one file per row
#   sd_path
#     sd_path : on-SD path relative to /media/fat (mirrors the DB layout)
#     url     : absolute http(s) source for the exact hosted file
#     size    : file size in bytes (integer)
#     md5     : lowercase 32-hex MD5 of the hosted file
#     tags    : space-separated Downloader filter tags (users can filter these
#               out of the sync
# TODO(maintainer): the url + size + md5 below are UNKNOWN and MUST be pinned
# against the exact hosted artifact before release.  Rows with a TODO_ field
# are SKIPPED by mkdb.py (with a warning) — the DB is still valid
# just won't be offered until a real url+size+md5 is filled in.  Do NOT invent
# hashes.  Note the shareware distribution ships pak0.pak inside an archive
# (quake106.zip / resource.1)
